feature_contract.goal: Ensure the complete R84 game HUD two-eye failure path never presents a stale right eye after left drawing or shader-constant rollback failures across fixed-function XYZRHW and shader HUD geometry.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R30 physical two-eye HUD/XZYRHW drawing and failed original WVP restoration only. Ordinary successful render, lower R29 bypass, F11, GOAL, stage +TIME, world, SkyGlow, depth and legacy R26_SAFE must remain unchanged.
trace_stages: Original game fixed-function/XYZRHW or shader HUD draw enters the independent R84 R30 two-eye dispatcher.
R30 left eye can fail after a depth/stencil write or during c64 rollback, before submitting current right-eye draws.
R29 frame-right-failed state feeds R84 Present/host publication safety; affected eye invalidation precedes future mono recovery.
subcomponents: Protect R30ExecuteXyzrhwStereo left HRESULT failure with present-frame veto and right depth/stencil invalidation.
Protect R30TryScreenSpaceFovDraw left HRESULT failure with the same current-frame veto after its c64 restore.
Protect failed initial left c64 rollback while retaining original healthy E_NOTIMPL fallback; enforce source-scoped negative mutations.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 GPU HUD two-eye drawing in XYZRHW and shader/VS routes
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Any failed left Draw marks this frame's right eye failed and invalidates left-written depth before future mono recovery.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Initial c64 upload rollback and successful original HUD rendering
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A successful rollback preserves the R29 E_NOTIMPL fallback, a failed rollback vetoes current Present, and successful HUD output, GOAL and SkyGlow remain unchanged.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 Win32 x86 game and 64-bit OpenXR host/active ZIP
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Validation-bearing SHA passes complete Active Game/Host/Package, Domain Isolation and affected Full Source Impact gates, with HMD separately UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R33 already poisons current-eye publication on left Draw failure, but both R30ExecuteXyzrhwStereo and R30TryScreenSpaceFovDraw previously returned after logging/arming future mono safety without marking current right-eye failed.
diagnosis.root_cause: R30 left-eye early failure path lacked a same-frame right-eye publication veto and potential right depth/stencil invalidation; a failed shader c64 rollback could likewise leave an incomplete present frame.
source_trace: R30 CPU-transformed XYZRHW left raw Draw can fail after stereo-draw-no-mono-backup was recorded.
R30 shader HUD left vertex constants upload and original rollback can fail before or after physical left Draw.
R29OwnerMarkRightDrawFailed sets FrameRightDrawFailed read by R84 Present; R29OwnerInvalidateRightDepthStencilIfLeftMayWrite blocks reusing unmatched right-eye content.
alternatives_rejected: Do not force a redundant right-eye draw after failed left Draw or submit stale historical mono backup; preserve successful R29 fallback if the initial left c64 rollback succeeds.
Do not disable stencil/depth or alter game 2D HUD positioning, SkyGlow, GOAL, +TIME or unrelated world effects.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Both R30 left failure branches now mark same-frame right-eye failure and invalidate right depth/stencil before reporting, while failed c64 rollback alone poisons the frame and still preserves the healthy E_NOTIMPL fallback.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Extended existing mandatory verify_vr_stereo_restore_publication.py with 9 left-failure/rollback scoped negative mutations plus existing 8 right-restore mutants.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R84 R29FrameRightDrawFailed is the existing present-time publication veto; this new material updates both R30 physical submissions without changing R33 per-eye state or OpenXR host.

runtime_evidence: No Quest3/VDXR HMD, game-screen or runtime evidence was acquired.
